content.value: Imagine a buyer is asking for the following dry processes on ordered 5-pkt basic denim pant. Hlustrate and locate the areas of a denim pan where you can add/ perform the operations:
i) Whisker, ii) Hand scraping, iii) Tagging, iv) Patch (3), v) Grinding, vi) Damage (3), and vii) PP touch.
